Change c0409. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. IV; 1831 Ch. XXI.

Context before (unchanged): I suppose some astonishment was exhibited in my countenance; for Mr. Kirwin hastened to say—

1818 text: "It was not until a day or two after your illness that I thought of examining your dress, that I might discover some trace by which I could send to your relations an account of your misfortune and illness.

1831 text: "Immediately upon your being taken ill, all the papers that were on your person were brought me, and I examined them that I might discover some trace by which I could send to your relations an account of your misfortune and illness.

Diff: " [-It was not until a day or two after-] {+Immediately upon+} your [-illness-] {+being taken ill, all the papers+} that [-I thought of examining-] {+were on+} your [-dress-] {+person were brought me+} , {+and I examined them+} that I might discover some trace by which I could send to your relations an account of your misfortune and illness.

Context after (unchanged): I found several letters, and, among others, one which I discovered from its commencement to be from your father.

result.rationale: Changes the sequence of events: Kirwin examined Victor's effects 'a day or two after' his illness in 1818, but 'Immediately upon' his being taken ill in 1831, with 'all the papers' brought to him. Procedure and timing change; no wider thematic effect.
